description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Mr. U. P. A. D. A. K. Karunanayaka Vs. National Institute of Education and etc. (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders appointing arbitrators to settle industrial disputes between employees and employers. It contains statutory instruments, legal notices, and regulatory procedures for dispute resolution, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
